name: brainforge-second-brain-installer
description: A local-first AI second brain installer for Claude Code, Codex, Obsidian, and MCP.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('tmp/smoke',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('tmp/smoke/AI-Brain-Imports',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync('tmp/smoke/AI-Brain-Imports/conversations.json', JSON.stringify([{title:'Smoke Test',messages:[{role:'user',content:'My name is Smoke User. I prefer local privacy, backups before config edits, and plan research refined plan build test review improve release workflows. My goal is to make Claude and Codex share one AI-Brain.'},{role:'assistant',content:'Create an Obsidian vault, parse AI chat exports, embed chunks locally, and expose search through MCP.'}]}]));" && node dist/cli.js setup --brain-dir ./tmp/smoke/AI-Brain --imports-dir ./tmp/smoke/AI-Brain-Imports --yes --json && node dist/cli.js company start --brain-dir ./tmp/smoke/AI-Brain --objective "Ship BrainForge as a local AI engineering company" --json && node dist/cli.js company advance --brain-dir ./tmp/smoke/AI-Brain --summary "Smoke initial plan completed" --evidence "smoke script" --json && node dist/cli.js company status --brain-dir ./tmp/smoke/AI-Brain --json && node dist/cli.js import --brain-dir ./tmp/smoke/AI-Brain --imports-dir ./tmp/smoke/AI-Brain-Imports --embedding-provider hash --json && node dist/cli.js search "local privacy codex claude" --brain-dir ./tmp/smoke/AI-Brain --json && node dist/cli.js review --brain-dir ./tmp/smoke/AI-Brain --approve-all --json && node dist/cli.js doctor --brain-dir ./tmp/smoke/AI-Brain --json
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run smoke && npm pack --dry-run
